## Functions

```{r}
save_tinytable_body <- function(tt, file) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".tex")

  tinytable::save_tt(
    tt,
    output = tmp
  )

  tex <- readLines(tmp, warn = FALSE)

  # Find the actual table body environment used by tinytable
  start <- grep(
    "\\\\begin\\{(tblr|talltblr|longtblr|tabular)\\}",
    tex,
    perl = TRUE
  )[1]

  end <- tail(
    grep(
      "\\\\end\\{(tblr|talltblr|longtblr|tabular)\\}",
      tex,
      perl = TRUE
    ),
    1
  )

  if (is.na(start) || is.na(end)) {
    stop("Could not find a tblr/talltblr/longtblr/tabular environment.")
  }

  tex_body <- tex[start:end]

  # PDF renders wrap numeric cells in \num{...}; the manuscript table
  # fragments use plain numbers. Strip the wrappers so HTML and PDF renders
  # export identical table bodies.
  tex_body <- gsub("\\\\num\\{([^{}]*)\\}", "\\1", tex_body)

  writeLines(tex_body, con = file)
}
```

## Directories

```{r}
# Root directory of the replication package (the folder containing the 'Data'
# and 'Writing' folders). Rendering from the repository root makes
# normalizePath(".") resolve to the correct location. If you run the chunks
# interactively from another working directory, replace this with the absolute
# path to the package folder.
root_dir <- normalizePath(".")

data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "Data")
writing_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "Writing")

# The analysis exports figures and tables into these subfolders. Create them if
# they are missing so that a fresh clone runs without manual setup.
dir.create(
  file.path(writing_dir, "Figures"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
dir.create(
  file.path(writing_dir, "Tables"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# Dataset Generation

## Import data

```{r}
session_numbers <- 1:26

df <- map_dfr(session_numbers, function(num) {
  file_path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("Session", num, ".xlsx"))

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    warning("Missing file: ", file_path)
    return(NULL)
  }

  read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Session1") %>%
    select(-any_of(c("prolificID", "Consent", "participant"))) %>%
    rename(treatment = Traitement) %>%
    mutate(
      session2 = num,
      participant = row_number(),
      across(everything(), as.character)
    )
})
```

##  Create Variables for Payoffs and Treatments 

```{r}
# Recode treatment names

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = recode(
      treatment,
      "Lie_Prosocial" = "Lie_Giving",
      "Lie_Antisocial" = "Lie_Taking",
      "Luck_Prosocial" = "Luck_Giving",
      "Luck_Antisocial" = "Luck_Taking",
      "Bsl_Prosocial" = "Bsl_Giving",
      "Bsl_Antisocial" = "Bsl_Taking",
      "Prosocial_Lie" = "Giving_Lie",
      "Antisocial_Lie" = "Taking_Lie"
    )
  )

# Create other variables

lie_treatments <- c(
  "Lie_Giving",
  "Lie_Taking",
  "Giving_Lie",
  "Taking_Lie"
)

bsl_treatments <- c("Bsl_Giving", "Bsl_Taking")
luck_treatments <- c("Luck_Giving", "Luck_Taking")

Giving_treatments <- c(
  "Bsl_Giving",
  "Lie_Giving",
  "Luck_Giving",
  "Giving_Lie"
)

Taking_treatments <- c(
  "Bsl_Taking",
  "Lie_Taking",
  "Luck_Taking",
  "Taking_Lie"
)

# Task 1 earnings
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    task1_earnings = case_when(
      Dice_Sum == 7 ~ 0.5,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(6, 8) ~ 1,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(5, 9) ~ 1.5,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(4, 10) ~ 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(3, 11) ~ 2.5,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(2, 12) ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Luck_payoff = if_else(
      is.na(Luck_payoff) & !is.na(payoffLuck),
      payoffLuck,
      Luck_payoff
    ),
    task1_earnings = case_when(
      treatment %in% luck_treatments ~ Luck_payoff,
      treatment %in% bsl_treatments ~ Bsl_payoff,
      TRUE ~ task1_earnings
    )
  )

# Task 2 Earnings
df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment), treatment != "") %>%
  mutate(
    task2_earnings = case_when(
      treatment %in% Giving_treatments ~ 3 - amount_give,
      treatment %in% Taking_treatments ~ amount_take,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Treatment Identifiers
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    BSL_treatment = as.integer(treatment %in% bsl_treatments),
    LIE_treatment = as.integer(treatment %in% lie_treatments),
    LUCK_treatment = as.integer(treatment %in% luck_treatments),
    Giving_frame = as.integer(treatment %in% Giving_treatments),
    Taking_frame = as.integer(treatment %in% Taking_treatments),

    treatment_num = case_when(
      treatment == "Bsl_Giving" ~ 1,
      treatment == "Luck_Giving" ~ 2,
      treatment == "Lie_Giving" ~ 3,
      treatment == "Bsl_Taking" ~ 4,
      treatment == "Luck_Taking" ~ 5,
      treatment == "Lie_Taking" ~ 6,
      treatment == "Giving_Lie" ~ 7,
      treatment == "Taking_Lie" ~ 8,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    Lie_TaskRnd = case_when(
      treatment %in% c("Lie_Giving", "Lie_Taking") ~ 1,
      treatment %in% c("Giving_Lie", "Taking_Lie") ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    TreatmentSet = case_when(
      treatment %in%
        c(
          "Bsl_Giving",
          "Luck_Giving",
          "Lie_Giving",
          "Bsl_Taking",
          "Luck_Taking",
          "Lie_Taking"
        ) ~ 1,
      treatment %in% c("Giving_Lie", "Taking_Lie") ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_label = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c(
        "Bsl_Giving",
        "Luck_Giving",
        "Lie_Giving",
        "Bsl_Taking",
        "Luck_Taking",
        "Lie_Taking",
        "Giving_Lie",
        "Taking_Lie"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Base–Give",
        "Luck-Give",
        "Lie–Give",
        "Base–Take",
        "Luck-Take",
        "Lie–Take",
        "Give–Lie",
        "Take–Lie"
      )
    )
  )
```

## Create Social Appropriateness Variables

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SocialApp_T2Choice = case_when(
      !is.na(amount_give) & amount_give < 0.5 ~ SocialApp_Give_00,
      !is.na(amount_give) &
        amount_give < 1.0 &
        amount_give >= 0.5 ~ SocialApp_Give_05,
      !is.na(amount_give) &
        amount_give < 1.5 &
        amount_give >= 1.0 ~ SocialApp_Give_10,
      !is.na(amount_give) &
        amount_give < 2.0 &
        amount_give >= 1.5 ~ SocialApp_Give_15,
      !is.na(amount_give) &
        amount_give < 2.5 &
        amount_give >= 2.0 ~ SocialApp_Give_20,
      !is.na(amount_give) &
        amount_give < 3.0 &
        amount_give >= 2.5 ~ SocialApp_Give_25,
      !is.na(amount_give) & amount_give == 3.0 ~ SocialApp_Give_30,

      !is.na(amount_take) & amount_take < 0.5 ~ SocialApp_Take_00,
      !is.na(amount_take) &
        amount_take < 1.0 &
        amount_take >= 0.5 ~ SocialApp_Take_05,
      !is.na(amount_take) &
        amount_take < 1.5 &
        amount_take >= 1.0 ~ SocialApp_Take_10,
      !is.na(amount_take) &
        amount_take < 2.0 &
        amount_take >= 1.5 ~ SocialApp_Take_15,
      !is.na(amount_take) &
        amount_take < 2.5 &
        amount_take >= 2.0 ~ SocialApp_Take_20,
      !is.na(amount_take) &
        amount_take < 3.0 &
        amount_take >= 2.5 ~ SocialApp_Take_25,
      !is.na(amount_take) & amount_take == 3.0 ~ SocialApp_Take_30,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    SocialApp00_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_30,
      SocialApp_Take_00
    ),
    SocialApp05_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_25,
      SocialApp_Take_05
    ),
    SocialApp10_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_20,
      SocialApp_Take_10
    ),
    SocialApp15_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_15,
      SocialApp_Take_15
    ),
    SocialApp20_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_10,
      SocialApp_Take_20
    ),
    SocialApp25_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_05,
      SocialApp_Take_25
    ),
    SocialApp30_T2Environ = if_else(
      Giving_frame == 1,
      SocialApp_Give_00,
      SocialApp_Take_30
    )
  )
```

## Create Personality Variables

```{r}
reverse_1_to_5 <- function(x) {
  if_else(!is.na(x), 6 - x, NA_real_)
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Machiavel = rowMeans(across(paste0("SDarkT_Mach_", 1:9)), na.rm = TRUE),

    SDarkT_Narc_2 = reverse_1_to_5(SDarkT_Narc_2),
    SDarkT_Narc_6 = reverse_1_to_5(SDarkT_Narc_6),
    SDarkT_Narc_8 = reverse_1_to_5(SDarkT_Narc_8),
    Narciss = rowMeans(across(paste0("SDarkT_Narc_", 1:9)), na.rm = TRUE),

    SDarkT_Psych_2 = reverse_1_to_5(SDarkT_Psych_2),
    SDarkT_Psych_7 = reverse_1_to_5(SDarkT_Psych_7),
    Psychop = rowMeans(across(paste0("SDarkT_Psych_", 1:9)), na.rm = TRUE),

    SBig5_1 = reverse_1_to_5(SBig5_1),
    SBig5_3 = reverse_1_to_5(SBig5_3),
    SBig5_4 = reverse_1_to_5(SBig5_4),
    SBig5_5 = reverse_1_to_5(SBig5_5),
    SBig5_7 = reverse_1_to_5(SBig5_7),

    Extraversion = (SBig5_1 + SBig5_6) / 2,
    Agreeableness = (SBig5_2 + SBig5_7) / 2,
    Conscientiousness = (SBig5_3 + SBig5_8) / 2,
    Neuroticism = (SBig5_4 + SBig5_9) / 2,
    Openness = (SBig5_5 + SBig5_10) / 2
  )
```

## Factor Variables for Earnings

```{r}
df <- df %>%

    task2_earnings_factor = case_when(

  )
```

## Pooling Dice Sum Variables and Adding Theoretical Frequencies

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Theor_Sum_freq = case_when(
      Dice_Sum == 7 ~ 16.6,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(6, 8) ~ 13.8,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(5, 9) ~ 11.1,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(4, 10) ~ 8.3,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(3, 11) ~ 5.5,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(2, 12) ~ 2.7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    Dice_Sum_Pool_dumy = case_when(
      Dice_Sum %in% c(2, 12) ~ 1,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(3, 11) ~ 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(4, 10) ~ 3,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(5, 9) ~ 4,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(6, 8) ~ 5,
      Dice_Sum == 7 ~ 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    Theor_Sum_Pool_freq = case_when(
      Dice_Sum == 7 ~ 16.6,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(6, 8) ~ 13.8 * 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(5, 9) ~ 11.1 * 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(4, 10) ~ 8.3 * 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(3, 11) ~ 5.5 * 2,
      Dice_Sum %in% c(2, 12) ~ 2.7 * 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

## General Data Exploration

### Descriptive Statistics General

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(task1_earnings, task2_earnings, starts_with("SocialApp")),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = ~ sum(!is.na(.x))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  kable()
```

### Descriptive Statistics Related to Balancing

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(TreatmentSet == 1) %>%
  group_by(treatment, task1_earnings) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_task2 = mean(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_task2 = sd(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(task2_earnings)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(treatment, task1_earnings) %>%
  kable()
```

### Graph of Task 2 Earnings by Treatment

```{r}
task2_avg <- df %>%
  group_by(
    treatment_num,
    treatment,
    task1_earnings,
    Giving_frame,
    TreatmentSet
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    task2_earnings_avg = mean(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_task2_task1 <- task2_avg %>%
  filter(TreatmentSet == 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    factor(task1_earnings),
    task2_earnings_avg,
    fill = factor(treatment_num)
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~treatment, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Task 1 Earnings",
    y = "Average Task 2 Earnings",
    fill = "Treatment"
  )

p_task2_task1

ggsave(
  file.path(writing_dir, "Figures", "task2vtask1.pdf"),
  p_task2_task1,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```

### OLS Regression on Task 2 Earnings Full Sample

```{r}
main_data <- df %>%
  filter(TreatmentSet == 1)

m1 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ task1_earnings +
    Giving_frame +
    LIE_treatment +
    LUCK_treatment,
  data = main_data
)

m2 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ task1_earnings +
    I(task1_earnings^2) +
    Giving_frame +
    LIE_treatment +
    LUCK_treatment +
    task1_earnings:Giving_frame +
    task1_earnings:LIE_treatment +
    task1_earnings:LUCK_treatment,
  data = main_data
)

m3 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~
    task1_earnings +
    I(task1_earnings^2) +
    Giving_frame +
    LIE_treatment +
    LUCK_treatment +
    task1_earnings:Giving_frame +
    task1_earnings:LIE_treatment +
    task1_earnings:LUCK_treatment +
    I(task1_earnings^2):Giving_frame +
    I(task1_earnings^2):LIE_treatment +
    I(task1_earnings^2):LUCK_treatment,
  data = main_data
)

m_soc1 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~
    (task1_earnings + I(task1_earnings^2)) *
    (Giving_frame + LIE_treatment + LUCK_treatment) +
    SocialApp_T2Choice,
  data = main_data
)

m_soc2 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~
    (task1_earnings + I(task1_earnings^2)) *
    (Giving_frame + LIE_treatment + LUCK_treatment) +
    SocialApp00_T2Environ +
    SocialApp05_T2Environ +
    SocialApp10_T2Environ +
    SocialApp15_T2Environ +
    SocialApp20_T2Environ +
    SocialApp25_T2Environ +
    SocialApp30_T2Environ,
  data = main_data
)

coef_map <- c(
  "task1_earnings" = "Task 1 Earnings",
  "Giving_frame" = "Giving Frame",
  "LIE_treatment" = "Lie Treatment",
  "LUCK_treatment" = "Luck Treatment",
  "I(task1_earnings^2)" = "Task 1 Earnings$^2$",
  "task1_earnings:Giving_frame" = "Giving Frame $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings",
  "task1_earnings:LIE_treatment" = "Lie Treatment $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings",
  "task1_earnings:LUCK_treatment" = "Luck Treatment $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings",
  "I(task1_earnings^2):Giving_frame" = "Giving Frame $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings$^2$",
  "I(task1_earnings^2):LIE_treatment" = "Lie Treatment $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings$^2$",
  "I(task1_earnings^2):LUCK_treatment" = "Luck Treatment $\\times$ Task 1 Earnings$^2$",
  "(Intercept)" = "Constant"
)

models <- list(
  "(1)" = m1,
  "(2)" = m2,
  "(3)" = m3,
  "(4)" = m_soc1,
  "(5)" = m_soc2
)

add_rows <- tibble(
  term = c(
    "Social App. T2 Choice",
    "Social App. T2 Frame"
  ),
  "(1)" = c("", ""),
  "(2)" = c("", ""),
  "(3)" = c("", ""),
  "(4)" = c("$\\checkmark$", ""),
  "(5)" = c("", "$\\checkmark$")
)

gof_map <- tibble(
  raw = "nobs",
  clean = "N",
  fmt = 0
)

stars_custom <- c(
  "*" = 0.10,
  "**" = 0.05,
  "***" = 0.01
)

Regress_General <- modelsummary(
  models,
  coef_map = coef_map,
  add_rows = add_rows,
  gof_map = gof_map,
  stars = stars_custom,
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  escape = FALSE,
  output = "tinytable"
)

Regress_General <- group_tt(
  Regress_General,
  j = list("T2 Earnings" = 2:6)
)

save_tinytable_body(
  Regress_General,
  file.path(writing_dir, "Tables", "Regress_General.tex")
)

Regress_General
```

#### Statistical Tests 

Distributional Differences (Kolmogorov-Smirnov)

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Sum of 2 Dice Comparisons
dice_sum_sample <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1) %>%
  pull(Dice_Sum) %>%
  na.omit()

dice_sum_theoretical <- sample(
  1:6,
  size = length(dice_sum_sample),
  replace = TRUE
) +
  sample(1:6, size = length(dice_sum_sample), replace = TRUE)

print(
  ks.test(
    dice_sum_sample,
    dice_sum_theoretical #rnorm(length(dice_sum_sample), mean = 7, sd = 2.474873415) #distribution taken from https://towardsdatascience.com/modelling-the-probability-distributions-of-dice-b6ecf87b24ea
  )
)

# First Dice Throw Comparisons
dice_first_sample <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1) %>%
  pull(Dice_First) %>%
  na.omit()

dice_first_theoretical <- sample(
  1:6,
  size = length(dice_first_sample),
  replace = TRUE
)

print(
  ks.test(dice_first_sample, dice_first_theoretical) #runif(length(dice_first_sample), min = 1, max = 6))
)

# Second Dice Throw Comparisons
dice_second_sample <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1) %>%
  pull(Dice_Second) %>%
  na.omit()

dice_second_theoretical <- sample(
  1:6,
  size = length(dice_second_sample),
  replace = TRUE
)

print(
  ks.test(
    dice_second_sample,
    dice_second_theoretical #runif(length(dice_second_sample), min = 1, max = 6)
  )
)
```

One-sided binomial fischer exact test to determine if the frequency of reporting 7, 2, 12, 3, and 11 two-die sums is higher than reporting other die-sums.

```{r}
# 2/12 reported
observed_2_12 <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1, !is.na(Dice_Sum)) %>%
  summarise(observed_2_12 = sum(Dice_Sum %in% c(2, 12))) %>%
  pull(observed_2_12)

print(fisher.test(
  matrix(
    c(observed_2_12, 20, 360 - observed_2_12, 340),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  ),
  alternative = "greater"
))

# 3/11 reported
observed_3_11 <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1, !is.na(Dice_Sum)) %>%
  summarise(observed_3_11 = sum(Dice_Sum %in% c(3, 11))) %>%
  pull(observed_3_11)

print(fisher.test(
  matrix(
    c(observed_3_11, 40, 360 - observed_3_11, 320),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  ),
  alternative = "greater"
))

# 7 reported
observed_7 <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1, !is.na(Dice_Sum)) %>%
  summarise(observed_7 = sum(Dice_Sum %in% 7)) %>%
  pull(observed_7)

print(fisher.test(
  matrix(c(observed_7, 60, 360 - observed_7, 300), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  alternative = "less"
))

# 6 or 8 reported
observed_6_8 <- df %>%
  filter(Lie_TaskRnd == 1, !is.na(Dice_Sum)) %>%
  summarise(observed_6_8 = sum(Dice_Sum %in% c(6, 8))) %>%
  pull(observed_6_8)

print(fisher.test(
  matrix(c(observed_6_8, 100, 360 - observed_6_8, 260), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  alternative = "less"
))
```

### Hypothesis Testing

#### Graph


```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "100%"
# Moral Cleansing Graph
task2_avg <- df %>%
  mutate(
    task1_hyp_group = case_when(
      task1_earnings %in% c(2.5, 3.0) ~ "2.5/3.0",
      task1_earnings %in% c(0.5, 1.0) ~ "0.5/1.0",
      TRUE ~ as.character(task1_earnings)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(treatment, task1_hyp_group, treatment_label) %>%
  summarise(
    task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups = mean(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(task2_earnings))),
    ci_lower = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

MoralCleansing_Graph <- task2_avg %>%
  filter(
    treatment %in%
      c(
        "Bsl_Giving",
        "Lie_Giving",
        "Bsl_Taking",
        "Lie_Taking"
      ),
    task1_hyp_group == "2.5/3.0"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_label = factor(
      as.character(treatment_label),
      levels = c("Base–Take", "Lie–Take", "Base–Give", "Lie–Give")
    ),
    frame_group = factor(
      case_when(
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Give", "Lie–Give") ~ "Giving Frame",
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Take", "Lie–Take") ~ "Taking Frame"
      ),
      levels = c("Giving Frame", "Taking Frame")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = treatment_label,
    y = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups,
    fill = treatment_label
  )) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~frame_group,
    scales = "free_x",
    strip.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Base–Take" = "#1f4e79",
      "Lie–Take" = "#76a1c9",
      "Base–Give" = "#1f4e79",
      "Lie–Give" = "#76a1c9"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Task 2 Earnings",
    title = "Moral Cleansing: Task 1 Earnings = 2.5/3",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
    ),
    frame_group = factor(
      case_when(
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Give", "Luck-Give") ~ "Giving Frame",
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Take", "Luck-Take") ~ "Taking Frame"
      ),
      levels = c("Giving Frame", "Taking Frame")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = treatment_label,
    y = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups,
    fill = treatment_label
  )) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~frame_group,
    scales = "free_x",
    strip.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Base–Give" = "#1f4e79",
      "Luck-Give" = "#76a1c9",
      "Base–Take" = "#1f4e79",
      "Luck-Take" = "#76a1c9"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Task 2 Earnings",
    title = "Luck Cleansing: Task 1 Earnings = 2.5/3",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Luck Licensing Graph
task2_avg <- df %>%
  mutate(
    task1_hyp_group = case_when(
      task1_earnings %in% c(2.5, 3.0) ~ "2.5/3.0",
      task1_earnings %in% c(0.5, 1.0) ~ "0.5/1.0",
      TRUE ~ as.character(task1_earnings)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(treatment, task1_hyp_group, treatment_label) %>%
  summarise(
    task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups = mean(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(task2_earnings))),
    ci_lower = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

LuckLicensing_Graph <- task2_avg %>%
  filter(
    treatment %in%
      c(
        "Bsl_Giving",
        "Luck_Giving",
        "Bsl_Taking",
        "Luck_Taking"
      ),
    task1_hyp_group == "0.5/1.0"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_label = factor(
      as.character(treatment_label),
      levels = c("Base–Give", "Luck-Give", "Base–Take", "Luck-Take")
    ),
    frame_group = factor(
      case_when(
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Give", "Luck-Give") ~ "Giving Frame",
        treatment_label %in% c("Base–Take", "Luck-Take") ~ "Taking Frame"
      ),
      levels = c("Giving Frame", "Taking Frame")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = treatment_label,
    y = task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups,
    fill = treatment_label
  )) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~frame_group,
    scales = "free_x",
    strip.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Base–Give" = "#1f4e79",
      "Luck-Give" = "#76a1c9",
      "Base–Take" = "#1f4e79",
      "Luck-Take" = "#76a1c9"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Task 2 Earnings",
    title = "Luck Licensing: Task 1 Earnings = 0.5/1",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

LuckBalancing_Graph <- LuckCleansing_Graph + LuckLicensing_Graph

LuckBalancing_Graph

ggsave(
  file.path(writing_dir, "Figures", "LuckBalancing_Graph.pdf"),
  LuckBalancing_Graph,
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)
```

#### Parametric

OLS Luck Licensing 

```{r}
# Filter for Moral Licensing Data
luck_license_data <- df %>%
  filter(
    LIE_treatment == 0,
    task1_earnings %in% c(0.5, 1),
    TreatmentSet == 1
  )

m1 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ LUCK_treatment + Giving_frame,
  data = luck_license_data
)

m2 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ LUCK_treatment * Giving_frame,
  data = luck_license_data
)

m3 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ LUCK_treatment * Giving_frame + SocialApp_T2Choice,
  data = luck_license_data
)

m4 <- lm(
  task2_earnings ~ LUCK_treatment *
    Giving_frame +
    SocialApp00_T2Environ +
    SocialApp05_T2Environ +
    SocialApp10_T2Environ +
    SocialApp15_T2Environ +
    SocialApp20_T2Environ +
    SocialApp25_T2Environ +
    SocialApp30_T2Environ,
  data = luck_license_data
)

models <- list(
  "Main Effects" = m1,
  "Interaction" = m2 #,
  #"(3)" = m3,
  #"(4)" = m4
)

coef_map <- c(
  "LUCK_treatment" = "Luck Treatment",
  "Giving_frame" = "Giving Frame",
  "LUCK_treatment:Giving_frame" = "Luck $\\times$ Giving",
  "(Intercept)" = "Constant"
)

#add_rows <- tibble(
#  term = c(
#    "Social App. T2 Choice",
#    "Social App. T2 Frame"
#  ),
#  "(1)" = c("", ""),
#  "(2)" = c("", ""),
#  "(3)" = c("$\\checkmark$", ""),
#  "(4)" = c("", "$\\checkmark$")
#)

gof_map <- tibble(
  raw = "nobs",
  clean = "N",
  fmt = 0
)

stars_custom <- c(
  "*" = 0.10,
  "**" = 0.05,
  "***" = 0.01
)

Regress_LuckLicensing <- modelsummary(
  models,
  coef_map = coef_map,
  #add_rows = add_rows,
  gof_map = gof_map,
  stars = stars_custom,
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  escape = FALSE,
  output = "tinytable"
)

Regress_LuckLicensing <- group_tt(
  Regress_LuckLicensing,
  j = list("Task 2 Earnings" = 2:3) # if T1 Earnings = 0.5/1
)

save_tinytable_body(
  Regress_LuckLicensing,
  file.path(writing_dir, "Tables", "Regress_LuckLicensing.tex")
)

Regress_LuckLicensing
```

### Appropriatenss Checks

#### Task 1

Graph

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "100%"
social_dice_vars <- c(
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_30",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_25",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_20",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_15",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_10",
  "SocialApp_DiceNoLie",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_NoGain"
)

dice_long <- df %>%
  filter(TreatmentSet == 2) %>%
  select(treatment_num, all_of(social_dice_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -treatment_num,
    names_to = "choice",
    values_to = "appropriateness"
  ) %>%
  group_by(treatment_num, choice) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(appropriateness)),
    mean_app = mean(appropriateness, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_app = sd(appropriateness, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_app = sd_app / sqrt(n),
    ci_low = mean_app - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_app,
    ci_high = mean_app + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_app,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dice_long <- dice_long %>%
  mutate(
    choice = factor(
      choice,
      levels = c(
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_30",
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_25",
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_20",
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_15",
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_10",
        "SocialApp_DiceNoLie",
        "SocialApp_DiceLie_NoGain"
      )
    )
  )

dice_treatment_labs <- c(
  "7" = "Give–Lie",
  "8" = "Take–Lie"
)

dice_choice_labs <- c(
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_30" = "2/12 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_25" = "3/11 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_20" = "4/10 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_15" = "5/9 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_10" = "6/8 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceNoLie" = "7 when 7",
  "SocialApp_DiceLie_NoGain" = "9 when 5"
)

bar_cols_dice <- c(
  "#76a1c9", # light blue",
  "#8b3f46",
  "#5b7f2b",
  "#e38900",
  "#6f8f87",
  "#cc003d",
  "#9a92d6"
)

p_dice <- ggplot(
  dice_long,
  aes(x = factor(treatment_num), y = mean_app, fill = choice)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
    width = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = dice_treatment_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bar_cols_dice, labels = dice_choice_labs) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 6.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Appro. of Dice Reporting",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Appropriateness on 6 Point Scale"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

p_dice

ggsave(
  file.path(writing_dir, "Figures", "SocialAppropDice.pdf"),
  p_dice,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
```

Paired signed-rank tests by treatment group

```{r}
signrank_dice_by_treatment <- df %>%
  filter(TreatmentSet == 2) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    p_NoLie_Lie30 = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        SocialApp_DiceNoLie,
        SocialApp_DiceLie_30,
        paired = TRUE,
        exact = FALSE,
        correct = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    p_NoLie_Lie25 = tryCatch(
```

Post-hoc rationalization test

```{r}
amount_give <- 3 - df$task2_earnings
amount_take <- df$task2_earnings
round_half <- function(x) round(x * 2) / 2

df_kw <- df %>%
  mutate(
    id = clusterind,
    chosen_amount = case_when(
      Giving_frame == 1 ~ round_half(3 - task2_earnings),
      Taking_frame == 1 ~ round_half(task2_earnings),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    frame = case_when(
      Giving_frame == 1 ~ "Give",
      Taking_frame == 1 ~ "Take",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

kw_give <- df_kw %>%
  filter(frame == "Give", !is.na(chosen_amount)) %>%
  select(
    id,
    treatment,
    treatment_label,
    task1_earnings,
    chosen_amount,
    SocialApp_Give_00,
    SocialApp_Give_05,
    SocialApp_Give_10,
    SocialApp_Give_15,
    SocialApp_Give_20,
    SocialApp_Give_25,
    SocialApp_Give_30
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("SocialApp_Give_"),
    names_to = "action",
    values_to = "appropriateness"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = "Give",
    action_amount = str_extract(action, "\\d+$") %>% as.numeric() / 10,
    chosen = as.integer(abs(action_amount - chosen_amount) < 1e-6)
  )

kw_take <- df_kw %>%
  filter(frame == "Take", !is.na(chosen_amount)) %>%
  select(
    id,
    treatment,
    treatment_label,
    task1_earnings,
    chosen_amount,
    SocialApp_Take_00,
    SocialApp_Take_05,
    SocialApp_Take_10,
    SocialApp_Take_15,
    SocialApp_Take_20,
    SocialApp_Take_25,
    SocialApp_Take_30
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("SocialApp_Take_"),
    names_to = "action",
    values_to = "appropriateness"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = "Take",
    action_amount = str_extract(action, "\\d+$") %>% as.numeric() / 10,
    chosen = as.integer(abs(action_amount - chosen_amount) < 1e-6)
  )

kw_long <- bind_rows(kw_give, kw_take) %>%
  filter(!is.na(appropriateness))

choice_comparison <- kw_long %>%
  group_by(domain, action_amount) %>%
  summarise(
    n_chosen = sum(chosen == 1),
    n_not_chosen = sum(chosen == 0),
    mean_if_chosen = mean(appropriateness[chosen == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_if_not_chosen = mean(appropriateness[chosen == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff = mean_if_chosen - mean_if_not_chosen,
    p_wilcox = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        appropriateness[chosen == 1],
        appropriateness[chosen == 0],
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

choice_comparison %>%
  arrange(domain, action_amount) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

For between treatment testing for social norm differences, we use the fisher randomization test which we include the function for below:

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Create Functions
fisher_randomization_test <- function(
  data,
  outcome,
  group,
  group1,
  group0,
  B = 10000,
  statistic = c("mean", "rank")
) {
  statistic <- match.arg(statistic)

  dat <- data %>%
    transmute(
      y = .data[[outcome]],
      g = .data[[group]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y), !is.na(g), g %in% c(group1, group0))

  n1 <- sum(dat$g == group1)
  n0 <- sum(dat$g == group0)

  if (n1 == 0 | n0 == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      n1 = n1,
      n0 = n0,
      mean1 = NA_real_,
      mean0 = NA_real_,
      observed_stat = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  stat_fun <- function(y, g) {
    if (statistic == "mean") {
      mean(y[g == group1], na.rm = TRUE) -
        mean(y[g == group0], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      r <- rank(y, ties.method = "average")
      mean(r[g == group1], na.rm = TRUE) -
        mean(r[g == group0], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  observed_stat <- stat_fun(dat$y, dat$g)

  perm_stats <- replicate(B, {
    g_perm <- sample(dat$g, replace = FALSE)
    stat_fun(dat$y, g_perm)
  })

  p_value <- (sum(abs(perm_stats) >= abs(observed_stat)) + 1) / (B + 1)

  tibble(
    outcome = outcome,
    n1 = n1,
    n0 = n0,
    mean1 = mean(dat$y[dat$g == group1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean0 = mean(dat$y[dat$g == group0], na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_stat = observed_stat,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}


run_fisher_tests <- function(
  data,
  outcomes,
  group,
  group1,
  group0,
  B = 10000,
  statistic = "mean"
) {
  map_dfr(
    outcomes,
    ~ fisher_randomization_test(
      data = data,
      outcome = .x,
      group = group,
      group1 = group1,
      group0 = group0,
      B = B,
      statistic = statistic
    )
  )
}

# Create Task 2 Group and Norm-Rating Variables

  mutate(
    Task2_group = case_when(

    )

  "SocialApp_Take_15",

  "SocialApp_Take_30"
)

# Run Tests

  data = df_rit %>% filter(TreatmentSet == 1),
  outcomes = give_norm_vars,
  group = "Task2_group",

# Apply Bonferroni Correction

  task2_give_rit,

) %>%

    observed_stat,
    p_value,
    p_bonferroni
  )

# Format for Table
fmt_p <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", x)
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {

}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12

# Moral Cleansing Graph
task2_avg <- df %>%
  mutate(
    task1_hyp_group = case_when(
      task1_earnings %in% c(2.5, 3.0) ~ "2.5/3.0",
      task1_earnings %in% c(0.5, 1.0) ~ "0.5/1.0",

    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(treatment, task1_hyp_group, treatment_label) %>%
  summarise(
    task2_earnings_avg_hypgroups = mean(task2_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
```

### Multiple Hypothesis Testing Correction

The tests reported above evaluate each hypothesis separately under the Giving Frame and the Taking Frame. We define four testing families, one for each hypothesis (luck cleansing, luck licensing, moral cleansing, and moral licensing), with each family containing the Giving- and Taking-frame comparisons. To control the family-wise error rate within each hypothesis, we apply the Bonferroni correction separately within each two-test family; adjusted p-values are calculated as min(1, 2p) using unrounded p-values.

```{r}
# Directory holding the LaTeX table fragment used by the manuscript
mht_table_dirs <- file.path(writing_dir, "Tables")

save_mht_table <- function(table, file_name) {
  for (target_dir in mht_table_dirs) {
    if (dir.exists(target_dir)) {
      save_tinytable_body(table, file.path(target_dir, file_name))
    }
  }
}

mht_fmt_p <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", x)
  )
}

mht_fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x))
}

# Main hypotheses and the Task 2 frames they are evaluated under
mht_specs <- tribble(
  ~hypothesis           , ~trt   , ~earn  ,
  "H1: Luck Cleansing"  , "Luck" , "high" ,
  "H2: Luck Licensing"  , "Luck" , "low"  ,
  "H3: Moral Cleansing" , "Lie"  , "high" ,
  "H4: Moral Licensing" , "Lie"  , "low"
)
```

```{r}
# Frame-specific non-parametric tests, adjusted within each hypothesis's
# two-test family (Giving and Taking frames) using Bonferroni
mht_frame_specs <- expand_grid(mht_specs, frame = c("Giving", "Taking"))

mht_frames <- pmap_dfr(
  list(
    mht_frame_specs$hypothesis,
    mht_frame_specs$trt,
    mht_frame_specs$earn,
    mht_frame_specs$frame
  ),
  function(hypothesis, trt, earn, frame) {
    earnings_set <- if (earn == "high") c(2.5, 3) else c(0.5, 1)
    treated_label <- paste0(trt, "_", frame)
    base_label <- paste0("Bsl_", frame)

    test_data <- df %>%
      filter(
        TreatmentSet == 1,
        treatment %in% c(base_label, treated_label),
        task1_earnings %in% earnings_set
      )

    test <- wilcox.test(
      task2_earnings ~ treatment,
      data = test_data,
      exact = FALSE,
      correct = FALSE
    )

    mean_treated <- mean(
      test_data$task2_earnings[test_data$treatment == treated_label]
    )
    mean_base <- mean(
      test_data$task2_earnings[test_data$treatment == base_label]
    )

    tibble(
      hypothesis = hypothesis,
      frame = frame,
      mean_base = mean_base,
      mean_treated = mean_treated,
      difference = mean_treated - mean_base,
      p_value = test$p.value,
      n_obs = nrow(test_data)
    )
  }
) %>%
  group_by(hypothesis) %>%
  mutate(p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni")) %>%
  ungroup()

mht_frames
```

```{r}
mht_frames_table_df <- mht_frames %>%
  transmute(
    Hypothesis = hypothesis,
    Frame = paste0(frame, " frame"),
    Base = mht_fmt_num(mean_base),
    Treated = mht_fmt_num(mean_treated),
    Difference = mht_fmt_num(difference),
    N = as.character(n_obs),
    `Raw $p$` = mht_fmt_p(p_value),
    `Adj. $p$` = mht_fmt_p(p_bonferroni)
  )

MHT_Frames_Table <- tt(mht_frames_table_df)

MHT_Frames_Table <- style_tt(
  MHT_Frames_Table,
  j = 1:2,
  align = "l"
)

MHT_Frames_Table <- style_tt(
  MHT_Frames_Table,
  j = 3:ncol(mht_frames_table_df),
  align = "c"
)

MHT_Frames_Table

save_mht_table(MHT_Frames_Table, "MHT_Frame_Tests.tex")
```
